text:
sam: FYI opened a GitOps PR to increase the gpu-pool in eu-west-1 by 4 (for baseline throughput). PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/PR-4212
leila: saw. Conftest/OPA check failed in pipeline, error says 'change during freeze window' :/
sam: ugh, weird — I checked the calendar, team freeze window starts tomorrow 00:00 UTC for quarter-end. This change is to support a canary job for the new batching kernel, we need capacity by tomorrow morning.
devops-bot: OPA policy 'freeze-window' blocked change: rule/freeze-window.v1 -> violation: 'no infra scaling during freeze 2026-03-19T00:00Z to 2026-03-22T23:59Z'
cheng: quick Q — why not schedule apply after the freeze? Is the canary blocking a customer rollout?
sam: the canary is low-risk but the dedicated jobs for perf tests are timeboxed, delaying would push the customer gating to next week and block release.
leila: we have two options: 1) request a formal exception via infra-exceptions (needs ENG TL + Security signoff) or 2) tweak the PR to use ephemeral spot nodes in a new temporary pool that doesn't touch reserved capacity. Both have tradeoffs.
jamie: cost note — adding 4 on-demand GPUs in eu-west-1 ~ +$9k/month. If we use spot it's ~+40% cheaper but preemptible. For a short canary (<48h) spot seems reasonable.
emma: I'm oncall — I can approve a short exception if we document rollback and add a canary guard (traffic cap + auto-destroy). But needs a manifest showing exact changes and a rollback plan.
sam: I updated PR with terraform plan snippet and an 'exception metadata' section. Pasting relevant bits: 
```
module.gpu_pool.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu_pool_changes:
  desired_capacity: 12 => 16
  tags:
    - key: maintenance_window
      value: 'q1-rollout'
```
leila: OPA also flagged missing 'change_owner' tag in the ASG. Add `change_owner: team-infra` and `change_reason` fields.
sam: added tags and the rollback target (desired_capacity=12) and TTL in terraform config. Also added a preapply smoke job that will destroy the ephemeral pool after 36h. PR link updated.
devops-bot: Conftest result: FAILED -> policy 'tag-requirements' missing: 'change_owner' (now present), 'maintenance' (missing)
cheng: what does 'maintenance' tag mean in our policies?
leila: 'maintenance' true/false required to indicate planned ops during restricted times. For exceptions we set maintenance=true and link to exception ID.
sam: updated tags again with `maintenance: true` and `exception_id: EXC-2987` (created in infra-exceptions doc).
jamie: make sure billing is CC'd or else finance will get surprised. Also, consider putting these nodes behind a separate subnetwork to avoid clashing routing rules in eu-west-1.
emma: I reviewed the PR diff and smoke script. Two asks before I approve exception: 1) add a Prometheus alert threshold for GPU utilization spike > 95% for 10m, and 2) add a simple canary traffic limiter in the rollout helm chart so we don't route heavy production traffic to new capacity.
sam: added alert in monitoring/alerts/gpu-canary.yaml and a helm values override file with `canary.maxWeight: 5`
leila: pipeline looks green now except for a lint warning about tf formatting. Can we fast-track the apply? We need to record the approval in the exception tracker.
emma: I've signed off in the infra-exceptions doc and left a note with the approval TTL (36h). Approving in Slack for audit: +1 from emma (oncall) and +1 from leila (infra TL).
devops-bot: Manual override submitted: infra-override workflow started by emma. Note: overrides get recorded to /vault/infra/exceptions with TTL.
sam: running `gitopsctl sync --pr 4212 --auto-approve-exception EXC-2987` now.
(devops-bot message): CI pipeline: plan -> apply (manual override). Plan summary: +4 gpu nodes, new tags, monitoring alerts, helm canary changes.
leila: reminder — update the OPA policy next sprint to support 'short-window exceptions' so we can avoid manual steps for low-risk bursts. File an RFC?
cheng: +1 to an RFC. Also we should add an acceptance test in our gitops pipeline that ensures `exception_id` is present when maintenance=true during freeze windows.
jamie: cost followup: I'll create a small dashboard showing this transient bump and project monthly burn with it.
sam: apply succeeded. Ephemeral pool created with spot nodes. Smoke jobs green. Scheduling destroy in 36h.
emma: thanks all. Please monitor the canary channels and alert if anything degrades.
leila: closing loop — PR merged, exception logged. Filing RFC for policy improvement: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/RFC-102
sam: closing thread, will post a short postmortem if anything unexpected happens. :thumbsup:
__notes: Must be a single continuous string of messages prefixed with sender. No title field per agents.md.
